purpose: One release-first reconciliation for Calendar and Prayer, explicitly separating historical approved art, images downloaded in CI, staged originals, public photo registry and actual slot rendering; NO re-approval or publication.
immutableRules: No new artwork, Calendar binding or Prayer placement is owner-approved by this data export.

Do not confuse 989 research art groups, 423 downloaded previews, 20 staged master files, 16 main-registry releases, 51 published Prayer slots or 507 accepted alternative relationships; they count different units.
The 423 downloaded images were research previews in GitHub Actions artifacts (383 after exact-pixel duplicate removal), not 423 production-ready image originals.
Artwork identity can never be inferred from artist+title alone where physical duplicates exist; four matching published images are strictly candidate slot pins already guarded in PR2830.
Global rejection overrides historical slot publication; the Albert Bouts CMA 1942.635 original is still present on pinned main and must be removed by tested change.
No new Commons-only file automatically joins curated photo pool without explicit owner selection; Prado photographic source remains disallowed.
Current 365-day source is the 2026 principal/proper census. M2M's additional eight navigation/alias targets are not actual canonical 267 Prayer art positions.
A public photo registry entry is not proof of a particular Calendar date artwork actually rendering in the running app; phone/source tests are separate.
No remote downloading, licensing assumptions, owner outreach, paid services, Vercel publication or modification of user-approved covers.

highPriorityExceptions.action: Merge/fix tested exclusion including removing public binary, preserve alternate Annunciation objects; verify Pages and cache.
Fix CI and merge four exact-work pinned Prayer photo uses, preserving 5 protected covers.
Complete 29 existing selections with asset/rights/native crops. Do not reselect art.
Integrate existing 75 draft curatorial dossiers; identify any missing actual painting in 15 explicit subject gap triage before owner review.
Deduplicate 73 source keys and reuse current 16-photo registry, archive20 and saved Action sources; do not download again before checking existing files.
Review 128 dates in one slate. 3 true named-work gaps; two partial martyr feast compositions must be labeled accurately.
Check existing 34 Class III and 71 Class IV contextual date mappings without new painting hunt.
